name: rune_screamer_mire_spit
for: Hollowmere Screamer 'mire spit' (side.rs SCREAMER_BLOWS, Motion::Rune, reach -1.0..1.0 m, height 0..2.0 m)
notes: A dark bog patch (~60 px = 2.1 m) spreads on the ground with bubbles welling up and popping and ripple rings (frames 1-12), the mire heaves up into a swelling dome (frames 13-15), then bursts (frame 16, the hit) into a spout of mud and bog water ~2.2 m tall with gobs and spray that fall back and splat, collapsing by frame 21. Built at the Screamer's density (102 px / 3.6 m). 24 frames @ 12 fps.
